svg.aria-label: More work. Four more. Each status says exactly how far along it is. Adelante: App Store · 1.1.0. A daily quote on your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch, with one rotation rule in Dart, Swift and Kotlin. TrustTrail: Web app live · beta. Lays out a secondhand deal’s evidence and shows the exact words behind each warning sign, privately in your browser. LetMeKnow: Web app live. Turns messages, bills and promises into open loops, with a plan to close each one. WayClub: Preview live · paused. Events, tickets and committee work for teams, clubs and communities, isolated per group in the database.
